name: Altomatic – 2-in-1 AI Image Optimization & Alt Text tool for speed, SEO, and accessibility
author: altomatic

sections.description:
The only WordPress plugin that combines image compression AND AI alt text generation in one.

Stop juggling multiple plugins. Altomatic automatically compresses your images to WebP and AVIF formats while generating accurate, SEO-optimized alt text using AI—all in a single upload.

Why Altomatic?

  • 2-in-1 Solution – Image compression + alt text generation in one plugin (no need for separate tools)
  • Improve Core Web Vitals – Smaller images = faster LCP scores
  • Better SEO – AI-written alt text helps Google understand your images
  • SEO Plugin Integration – Uses focus keyphrases from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and AIOSEO for keyword-rich alt text
  • Accessibility Compliance – Auto-generated descriptions for screen readers (EAA/ADA/WCAG)
  • WebP & AVIF Support – Next-gen formats with automatic browser fallback

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce stores – Optimize product images for faster load times and better product SEO
  • Bloggers & content creators – Focus on writing, not image optimization
  • Agencies – Bulk optimize client sites with one tool
  • Sites needing accessibility compliance – Meet EAA, ADA, and WCAG requirements automatically
  • Anyone who wants to pass Core Web Vitals – Fix image-related performance issues automatically

The Only All-in-One Solution

Most image optimization plugins only compress images. Most alt text plugins only generate descriptions. Altomatic does both, saving you money and simplifying your workflow.

  • Image Compression – Yes (compression-only plugins can’t generate alt text)
  • WebP/AVIF Conversion – Yes (alt text-only plugins can’t convert formats)
  • AI Alt Text Generation – Yes (compression-only plugins don’t do this)
  • Single Plugin – Yes, no need to install and pay for 2 separate tools

Key Features

Automatic Alt Text Generation
Every uploaded image is analyzed by AI and descriptive, SEO-friendly alt text is automatically added to the image properties. No manual work required — just upload and go.

Image Compression & Format Conversion
Compress images and convert to modern WebP and AVIF formats for dramatically smaller file sizes. The only alt text plugin that also optimizes your images — no second plugin needed.

Keyword-Rich Alt Text with SEO Plugin Integration
Seamlessly integrates focus keyphrases from popular SEO plugins, including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO (AIOSEO), to generate keyword-rich alt text that aligns with your on-page SEO strategy.

Optimized for WooCommerce
Automatically optimizes WooCommerce product images, thumbnails, and gallery images. AI-generated alt text helps your products appear in Google Image Search and improves product page SEO.

Supports Multiple Formats
Handles JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images. Convert to next-gen formats with automatic browser fallback for maximum compatibility across all devices.

Bulk Optimization
Use the bulk optimization tool to process your entire existing media library. Optimize hundreds of images and generate alt text with one click.

Core Web Vitals Ready
Smaller images directly improve your Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) score — one of Google’s key ranking factors. Fix image-related performance issues automatically.

Accessibility Compliance
Auto-generated alt text helps meet EAA, ADA, and WCAG 2.1 requirements for image descriptions. Support screen readers with accurate, meaningful image descriptions on every page.

Multiple Languages
AI alt text generation supports multiple languages, so your image descriptions match your site’s language.

Review and Edit
See what was processed and manually edit or regenerate the AI-generated alt text at any time. Full control over your image descriptions.

Try for FREE
50 free credits every month. No credit card needed to get started.

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings > Altomatic
  2. Click “Get API Key” – enter your email and a 6-digit verification code will be sent to you. Enter the code and your API key is saved automatically. Or paste an existing key from altomatic.ai/profile.
  3. Customize your settings:
    • Select image sizes to optimize
    • Choose output formats (WebP/AVIF/original)
    • Enable automatic alt text generation
    • Configure responsive image settings

Free plan includes 50 credits/month. Upgrade your plan for more.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Altomatic API (https://api.altomatic.ai) to perform image optimization and alt text generation. Your images are uploaded only during processing and are never made public or shared.

This plugin also connects to the Altomatic web application (https://altomatic.ai/api) for account authentication when using the “Get API Key” feature. This sends your email address to request a verification code and retrieve your API key.

See terms of use and privacy policy for more details.

Support & Contact

  • Website: https://altomatic.ai
  • Support Email: support@altomatic.ai
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Altomatic”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Or install manually:
1. Download the latest release from altomatic.ai/download
2. Upload the ZIP via WordPress or extract to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
sections.faq:
How does the AI alt text generator work?

Altomatic uses advanced AI to analyze each image and generate descriptive, SEO-friendly alt text automatically. The AI understands image content, objects, people, and context to write accurate descriptions. This saves you hours of manual work and ensures accessibility compliance.

Will image compression overwrite my originals?

No. Altomatic preserves your original images and creates optimized WebP/AVIF versions alongside them. You can always restore or re-optimize.

What image formats does Altomatic support?

Altomatic accepts JPEG, PNG, and GIF uploads and can convert them to:
– WebP – 25-35% smaller than JPEG with same quality
– AVIF – Up to 50% smaller than JPEG (newest format)
– Optimized JPEG – For browsers that don’t support WebP/AVIF

Why use Altomatic instead of separate compression and alt text plugins?

Most WordPress users need two plugins: one for image compression and one for alt text. Altomatic combines both features, saving you money and reducing plugin bloat. One dashboard, one subscription, complete image optimization.

Will this help my Core Web Vitals score?

Yes! Image optimization directly improves Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), one of the three Core Web Vitals. Smaller images = faster page loads = better scores. Images cause 80% of LCP issues on most sites.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or AIOSEO?

Yes! Altomatic automatically detects focus keyphrases from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO (AIOSEO). When generating alt text, the AI uses these keywords to create descriptions that align with your SEO strategy — no extra configuration needed.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Altomatic automatically optimizes WooCommerce product images, thumbnails, and gallery images. AI-generated alt text also helps your products appear in Google Image search and improves product page SEO.

Does Altomatic help with accessibility compliance (EAA, ADA, WCAG)?

Yes. The European Accessibility Act (EAA) and ADA require alt text on informational images. Altomatic automatically generates accurate alt text for every image, helping you meet WCAG 2.1 requirements without manual work.

Can I bulk optimize existing images?

Yes. Altomatic includes a bulk optimization tool that processes your entire media library. Optimize hundreds of images with one click.

How are credits used?

Credits are used per operation (1 credit per image size/format, 3 credits for alt text generation). Free tier includes 50 credits/month. Monitor usage at altomatic.ai/profile.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Images are transferred via HTTPS and temporarily processed on our servers. We don’t store or share your images beyond what’s needed for optimization.
